{{ElectionsMS}}
The '''2026 United States Senate election in Mississippi''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the state of [[Mississippi]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=United States Senate election in Mississippi, 2026|url=https://ballotpedia.org/United_States_Senate_election_in_Mississippi,_2026|access-date=April 19, 2025|website=[[Ballotpedia]]}}</ref> [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] incumbent [[Cindy Hyde-Smith]] is seeking re-election to a second full term. She is being challenged by [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] Lowndes County district attorney [[Scott Colom]].

[[Primary elections]] were held on March 10. Facing minimal opposition, Hyde-Smith won the Republican nomination with 80.8% of the vote. Colom won the Democratic nomination with 73% of the vote against Marine veteran Albert Littell and Priscilla Williams-Till, a cousin of [[Emmett Till]].<ref name="Colom2">{{cite news |last1=McRae |first1=Emma |date=September 3, 2025 |title=Colom announces Senate run for Hyde-Smith's seat |url=https://cdispatch.com/news/colom-announces-senate-run-for-hyde-smiths-seat/ |access-date=September 3, 2025 |work=[[The Commercial Dispatch]]}}</ref><ref name="WilliamsTill">{{cite news |last1=Harrison |first1=Heather |date=September 9, 2025 |title=Emmett Till's Cousin Is Running for US Senate in Mississippi |url=https://www.mississippifreepress.org/priscilla-williams-till-emmett-tills-cousin-is-running-for-us-senate-in-mississippi/ |access-date=September 9, 2025 |work=Mississippi Free Press}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Meet the US Senate candidates in Mississippi 2026 primary election |url=https://www.clarionledger.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/02/27/united-states-senate-candidates-election-2026-in-mississippi/88839755007/ |access-date=February 27, 2026 |website=Clarion Ledger}}</ref>

Democrats have not won a Senate election in Mississippi since [[1982 United States Senate election in Mississippi|1982]].
